name: Kanban Embed
changes: Add a card checks the lane name before it writes. If the board changed while you typed, the card goes to the lane that you saw, or nothing is written and a notice asks you to try again.
When more than one board in the embed has the lane, the add field shows a list to pick the board.
tip: Add hide-done: true to a kanban-embed block to hide checked cards and show how many are hidden.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Kanban Embed is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.
